### 1. Scene
A mixed appetizer/meat plate: a fresh shrimp summer roll, bone-in braised meat, additional cooked meat pieces, and breaded fried shrimp.

### 2. Vessel
A round disposable dinner plate, approximately **25 cm diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 12.5² ≈ **491 cm²**.

### 3. Items
- Fresh shrimp-and-lettuce rice-paper roll
- Braised meat on a bone, possibly lamb shank
- Dark cooked meat at the upper right
- Two browned meat pieces near the bottom
- Breaded fried shrimp on the right

No separate sauce or dressing is clearly visible. Frying oil is included in the fried food’s energy estimate.

### 8. Sanity check
